issues.current_content:
# File Encoding

This chapter will be populated with content from the codebase analysis.

*This content will be populated by the documentation drift detection workflow.*
issues.should_be: Comprehensive encoding documentation covering encoding modes, BOM sniffing, UTF-16 support, transcoding, and the --encoding flag
issues.fix_suggestion: Migrate the File Encoding section from GUIDE.md (lines 628-712) to book/src/file-encoding.md with appropriate adaptations for the book format

issues.description: The -E/--encoding flag is not documented in the chapter
issues.should_add: Document -E/--encoding flag with values: 'auto' (default), 'none', or any WHATWG encoding label (e.g., 'utf-16', 'latin1', 'gbk')
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section explaining the --encoding flag syntax, values, and behavior. Include that 'auto' uses BOM sniffing, 'none' disables encoding detection, and specific labels force transcoding.

issues.description: BOM (Byte Order Mark) sniffing mechanism is not explained
issues.should_add: Explain how ripgrep automatically detects UTF-8 and UTF-16 BOMs and transcodes accordingly. Note that BOM sniffing is enabled by default and can be disabled with --encoding=none or --no-encoding.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add detailed section on BOM sniffing: what it is, how it works, when it's applied (first 3 bytes), which encodings are detected (UTF-8, UTF-16LE, UTF-16BE), and how it interacts with explicit --encoding values.

issues.description: The transcoding process from source encoding to UTF-8 is not documented
issues.should_add: Explain that when an encoding is specified or detected, ripgrep transcodes the file content from that encoding to UTF-8 before searching. Invalid bytes are replaced with Unicode replacement character (U+FFFD).
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section explaining transcoding: when it occurs, performance implications, how invalid bytes are handled, and that BOM can override explicit --encoding setting.

issues.description: Three distinct encoding modes are not explained
issues.should_add: Document three encoding modes: Auto (BOM sniffing only), Some(encoding) (explicit encoding with BOM override), Disabled (no encoding detection, search raw bytes)
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section explaining the three encoding modes and how they correspond to command-line flags: Auto (--encoding=auto or --no-encoding), Some (--encoding=<label>), Disabled (--encoding=none).

issues.description: List of supported encodings is not provided
issues.should_add: List common encodings and reference to WHATWG Encoding Standard. Include examples: UTF-8, UTF-16LE, UTF-16BE, ISO-8859-1, GBK, EUC-JP, Shift_JIS, etc.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section listing commonly used encodings with examples. Reference the complete list at https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-encoding-get and note that all encodings from encoding_rs crate are supported.

issues.description: No examples showing how to use encoding features
issues.should_add: Provide practical examples: searching UTF-16 files automatically, forcing encoding, disabling BOM sniffing, searching raw bytes
issues.fix_suggestion: Add examples section with: 1) Basic UTF-16 search (automatic), 2) Force UTF-16 with --encoding=utf-16, 3) Search raw bytes with --encoding=none, 4) Search Cyrillic text with --encoding=windows-1251

issues.description: The ASCII compatibility assumption is not explained
issues.should_add: Explain that ripgrep assumes files are ASCII-compatible when no encoding is specified. This means ASCII, Latin-1, and UTF-8 work well, but non-ASCII-compatible encodings may not produce useful results without explicit --encoding.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section explaining ASCII compatibility assumption, why it matters, and which encodings are ASCII-compatible (ASCII, Latin-1, UTF-8) vs non-compatible (UTF-16, UTF-32 without BOM).

issues.description: Performance impact of transcoding is not mentioned
issues.should_add: Note that transcoding adds a performance penalty compared to searching UTF-8 directly
issues.fix_suggestion: Add brief note in relevant sections that transcoding has performance overhead and searches will be slower than native UTF-8 searches.

issues.description: How encoding interacts with Unicode regex features (\w, ., etc.) is not explained
issues.should_add: Explain that Unicode regex features like \w and . work on the UTF-8 transcoded version, and that (?-u) flag can disable Unicode matching within patterns.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section explaining regex Unicode features work on UTF-8 content, and cross-reference to the advanced patterns chapter for (?-u) flag usage.

issues.should_add: Document that -E is the short form of --encoding
issues.fix_suggestion: When documenting --encoding flag, include that -E is the short form (e.g., 'rg -E utf-16 pattern' is equivalent to 'rg --encoding utf-16 pattern')

issues.should_add: Document that --no-encoding resets encoding back to automatic mode (equivalent to --encoding=auto)
issues.fix_suggestion: Add note that --no-encoding flag can be used to reset encoding to auto mode, useful in combination with configuration files or when overriding earlier flags.
